text:
morgan: Quick design review: proposing a 'condense successes' toggle for the Private setup preflight. Goal: reduce visual noise during long scans but keep failures obvious. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new/preflight-condense (frame: condense-toggle). Thoughts? :mag:
tia: Love it. Important: when condensing, we still need a clear visible failure affordance at the top so users don't miss issues. consider a pinned failure strip.
devon: Agreed. Also prefer short status language on rows: use `Port open` / `Port closed` / `DNS ok` / `DNS error` to make it scannable.
sana: Accessibility: the summary band should use `aria-live="polite"` and `role="status"` so assistive tech gets an aggregate update, not every probe line. When condense toggles state, announce: "Results condensed: 4 hidden, 2 failing".
morgan: Good call. UX question: show condensed summary by default when >4 probes? Or let users toggle? I'm leaning to auto-condense for >6 with a visible toggle to expand.
tia: Auto-condense is fine if we expose the toggle and show an explicit summary line like: `Network checks — 8 of 12 passing (4 hidden)`. add a `Show all` CTA next to it.
devon: Implementation note: render placeholders for hidden rows to avoid layout jump when expanding. engineering will need fixed heights for rows. Also avoid rendering heavy detail components until expanded.
sana: Keyboard flow: condense control must be focusable. Enter expands and focus should move to first failing row. Escape collapses back and returns focus to the toggle. Use `aria-expanded` on the toggle.
morgan: Copy suggestions: summary: `Network checks — 8 of 12 passing`; collapsed hint: `4 hidden — Show failures`; row states: `Port open` / `Port closed` / `DNS resolved` / `DNS failed`; action: `Retry`.
tia: Small copy nit  prefer `passing` not `successful` per style guide. Also use sentence fragments for small labels.
devon: For flaky probes show amber icon + tooltip: `Intermittent — last 3: ok, ok, fail`. Tooltip must be keyboard accessible and exposed with `aria-describedby`.
sana: Color contrast: dimmed success text must still meet 4.5:1. If we must de-emphasize, rely on icon dimming, not text low contrast.
morgan: Mobile considerations: collapsed hint must have a large tap target; full-width `Show all` is better than a tiny chevron.
tia: Also add a small copy action: `Copy summary` on the summary band so users can paste condensed results into tickets. Ensure the copy toast is announced by `aria-live`.
devon: Performance cap: `Copy all` should cap at 10 probes and show `Truncated to 10 probes` in toast if there are more. Avoid serializing huge payloads on main thread.
sana: Accessibility checklist: aria-live summary, aria-expanded toggle, focus management, keyboard-accessible tooltips, contrast check, copy-to-clipboard announcement. I'll add this to the a11y doc.
morgan: Action items: I'll update Figma with auto-condense rules (>6), summary copy, and mobile examples; add a small spec for focus movement and placeholder heights. tagging @tia @devon @sana for sign-off.
